first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: An adult man with short hair combed back, wearing a black coat; in the first frame, his head, part of his upper body, and a small amount of white shirt collar are visible, after which he passes behind the foreground vertical post.

entities.name: Brick-and-stone wall
entities.identification: A gray to grayish-brown masonry wall surface in the background of the passage, with irregular masonry blocks, joints, and local areas of light-colored plaster.

entities.name: Wooden post-and-beam frame
entities.identification: A dark wooden component in the foreground; in this clip, a broad, thick vertical post is mainly discernible, and Person A passes behind it.

entities.name: Light-colored inclined surface by the window
entities.identification: A grayish-brown inclined surface area near the lower part of the window opening, with a diagonal boundary and darker patches.

entities.name: Window opening in the wall
entities.identification: A deep opening in the Brick-and-stone wall, with a light-colored thick window edge, a vertical side wall, and the lower windowsill edge visible.

entities.name: Green vegetation outside the window
entities.identification: A distant green band-like area visible through the Window opening in the wall, with alternating dark and light green and blurred details.
